subject: Maximum tree depth parameter now in git

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Maximum tree depth parameter now in git
parts:
I've pushed changes which add a maximum tree depth to NUTS.  It defaults to 10 and can be set from the command line of a generated model program by passing --max_treedepth.  Setting it to -1 will fall back to the previous behavior which does not limit the depth of the tree.

I haven't added a diagnostic to check how often this is hit but I pushed the changes anyway in case someone else has the time and motivation to do that.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: tree depth printing for Stan
parts:
I added code to print out the tree depth used at
each sample along with the other parameters in the
output.

I was surprised to see that the adaptation worked
so well for the Wishart sampler -- it rarely goes
above depth 2 (4 leapfrog steps).

The easiest way to code it turned out to be to
put a pair of virtual methods in the base class
underlying the NUTS and HMC samplers. These
print out the sampler-specific "parameter" names
and then for each sample, their values. It's currently
a no-op for HMC. But this will make it easier if
we want to return other sampler-specific diagnostic
info.

- Bob
